questiontext.text:
To give an answer in standard form, \(n \times 10^p\), type "n*10^p".


(a) Calculate \({@if integerp(first(aList)) then first(aList) else float(first(aList))@}\times10^4 + {@if integerp(second(aList)) then second(aList) else float(second(aList))@}\times10^3 + {@if integerp(third(aList)) then third(aList) else float(third(aList))@}\times10^5\)
Give you answer in standard form.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

(1)

[[feedback:prt1]]

(b) Calculate \(10^{@first(bList)@} \times 10^{@second(bList)@} \times 10^{@third(bList)@}\)
Give your answer as a power of 10.

[[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]]

(1)

[[feedback:prt2]]

(c) How many times longer is \({@if integerp(cTimeLongDec) then cTimeLongDec else float(cTimeLongDec)@} \times 10^{@cTimeLongPow@}\) {@first(cUnitsList)@} than \({@if integerp(cTimeShortDec) then cTimeShortDec else float(cTimeShortDec)@} \times 10^{@cTimeShortPow@}\) {@second(cUnitsList)@}?
Give your answer in standard form.

[[input:ans3]] [[validation:ans3]]

(2)

[[feedback:prt3]]

(d) What is the volume of a box with dimensions \({@if integerp(dLengthDec) then dLengthDec else float(dLengthDec)@} \times 10^{@dLengthPow@} \text{{@first(dUnitsList)@}}\) by \({@if integerp(dWidthCorrUnit) then dWidthCorrUnit else float(dWidthCorrUnit)@} \text{{@second(dUnitsList)@}}\) by \({@if integerp(dHeightDec) then dHeightDec else float(dHeightDec)@} \times 10^{@dHeightPow@} \text{{@third(dUnitsList)@}}\)?
Give your answer in standard form in \(\text{cm}^3\).

[[input:ans4]] \(\text{cm}^3\) [[validation:ans4]]

(3)

[[feedback:prt4]]
